contract.description: Create a tome manifest so memory_brief's tome table can route agents. Check the tome table first and write to the fitting tome; create only when no tome fits. key is a lowercase kebab-case tome key; description (1..280 chars after trim) must say what belongs there. Hard delete and manifest edit are human-only - no agent verbs exist for them.
contract.name: memory_tome_create
contract.title: Create a tome manifest
